question: How does meditating on the light form prevent one from falling into a state of insignificance?
premises: She is meditated upon by someone
That person is the subject of the result
A state of lightness or insignificance is negated
inference: One who meditates on her never falls into a state of insignificance.
uncertainties: The sense of laghutāpadam as insignificance versus lightness is ambiguous
plain_english: He by whom she is meditated upon will never here fall into a state of insignificance.
